title: DAY 25/90
JOINTS
scenes.sub: Bolts, rivets and welds: week five begins
scenes.voice: Day twenty five of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge, eighty two days to go! Week five opens with machine design: bolted, riveted and welded joints.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Today's subject is machine design. Our topic: joints. How bolts, rivets and welds carry load, and where each one fails first.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover bolt preload and joint stiffness, the tearing, shearing and crushing efficiency of riveted joints, fillet and butt welds, and eccentrically loaded joints.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
lines: s = leg size, l = weld length
scenes.voice: Quick tip. A fillet weld fails across its throat: zero point seven zero seven times the leg size. Load equals point seven zero seven, times leg, times length, times shear stress.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: The free practice PDF is on Telegram now. Test tonight, seven to nine P. M. Take it through our Telegram channel link, or simply visit our website, on mobile or laptop.

scenes.title: Day 24 Toppers
